name: curl-cffi
notes: Python-version-agnostic curl_cffi (browser TLS impersonation) via user's proven method: therealfreddied/curl-cffi-termux. Builds abi3 wheel from sdist with ephemeral -lc++->-lc++_shared patch (avoids /system/lib64/libc++.so __ndk1 ABI crash) + static libcurl-impersonate.a -> works on ANY Python >=3.10, self-contained. Stock pip is broken here: upstream android wheel links libpython3.13.so (off-by-one on other pythons). Idempotent: live impersonate='chrome' gate exits instantly when working; only --force rebuilds. Default pin curl_cffi==0.16.0 (known-good static-archive ABI). Recipe pins installer script by commit+sha256; hub's y-confirm is the approval gate for inner pkg/pip.
